videos.title: CRAFT (1979): The Rabbit | Episode 6
videos.description:
Head to https://latentdiffusion.tv for more!!

Something awaits beyond the peak.. but first you must get there.

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

**MUSIC BY JULIAN FAYMAN**
Spotify:
https://open.spotify.com/track/01kiO1fd5vZIUJQHmxXs5u?si=lvq0WiZFQtyJdYEYU3daTA&utm_source=copy-link
Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/julianfaymanmusic/

If you want to become a member to help make more episodes—and eventually a full movie—click below to visit my Patreon!

https://www.patreon.com/cw/LatentDiffusion

Patreon supporters get early access to episodes, behind-the-scenes content, extra updates, and a closer look at the process of making CRAFT.

Episode 6 of my fan-made, blockbuilding-game-inspired film series, imagining what it might have looked like if it were made in the 1970s!

Thank you for all the support on the first five episodes. In **Episode 6: The Rabbit**, Steve and Wolf leave the quiet village behind and follow the map into a frozen mountain pass. As night falls, a peaceful journey beneath the stars becomes a brutal fight for survival when a blizzard separates them.

Lost, injured, and nearly frozen, Steve must survive the storm while searching for his companion. But when the snow finally begins to clear, the path ahead reveals something far greater—and far more dangerous—than either of them expected.

If you’d like to try making videos like this yourself, I made a lot of the episode using Runway. You can use code **LATENTDIFFUSION25** for 25% off any plan:

That code also specifically helps support me and the project.

Join the CRAFT Community on Discord to share ideas and talk about the story, lore, theories, filmmaking process, and more!

This was made using AI as a tool, but it was not solely AI-generated. I also did extensive manual sound design, Photoshop editing, Premiere editing, effects work, visual cleanup, color grading, compositing, and shot-by-shot adjustments.

The story and script were **not written by AI**, but by me and my small team!
